about_the_game:
Ravenmoore Psychiatric Hospital:

Enter an oppressive and terrifying environment where you play as a young man who infiltrates the old and abandoned Ravenmoore Psychiatric Hospital in search of the harsh reality hidden behind this place, but what you least expected was to end up discovering something much worse than you could ever have imagined.

Remember that every sound is a sign of danger...

Synopsis:
Kaelix Drum, a boy obsessed with exploring abandoned places, is led by his curiosity to Ravenmoore, the abandoned psychiatric hospital in his town, where he finds what he least wanted to find...

Monsters and creatures

This place is full of secrets, monsters, very disturbing places, and endless horrible things...

You will have to deal with every danger in this place if you want to survive and unearth what has been hidden for years.

This place ceased to be what it once was a long time ago, due to inexplicable events that still offer no clue as to what happened. But what is certain is that there are extremely dangerous creatures here. Be careful when exploring this place and don't let HER fool you. What could happen to you is much worse than you can imagine...


EVERYTHING WILL BE REVEALED....

Key Features:
A dark and immersive atmosphereExploration and immersive, realistic gameplay

Secrets and Easter eggs

Intriguing and mysterious characters

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 980 or AMD equivalent (R9 380 / RX 460)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 SUPER
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
